text:
Maria H.: Hey team — AcmeHealth POC update. They sent a PO and want:
- Net45 terms on the invoice
- KMS language that references their vendor-managed HSM
- Countersign by CFO + delivery of invoice before signature

Can legal/finance confirm acceptable path? I'm proposing we accept the PO for provisioning but require MSA countersign after our redlines. Need signer order and invoice remit.

Marcus B.: cc @Samir L. and @June F. — sales wants to avoid a full contract hold up. If we can accept PO as a payment trigger for the POC infra that'd keep momentum.

Samir L.: Quick take: we can't accept a blanket vendor-managed KMS clause. We should:
- Reject "vendor-managed HSM" phrasing
- Propose: only customer-provided keys via our supported KMS integrations OR approved third-party HSMs listed in Appendix A
- Add audit and breach notification windows (30 days)
I'll post a redline tonight. :writing_hand:

June F.: Finance: Net30 is standard. For POC <$50k we can do Net45 once (one-off) if billing sends to billing@acmehealth.com and PO number is on invoice. Also need to confirm tax form if they're in EMEA.

Oleg P.: From the buyer side: CFO insists on seeing an executed order (PO + signature) before unlocking budget. They asked if DocuSign can be single-envelope (buyer signs then we countersign). Also asked about prorated usage credits if they scale mid-quarter.

Maria H.: Proposed operational flow:
1) We provision POC on receipt of PO (scan + small charge) — mark as provisioning-only
2) We send invoice to billing@acmehealth.com with PO number and Net45 if approved by finance
3) Buyer signs orderform in DocuSign (one click)
4) Legal countersigns MSA after Samir's redline accepted
5) Once MSA countersigned, transition from provisioning to production settings

Marcus B.: Envelope order suggestion:
- Signer 1: AcmeHealth CFO (signs orderform)
- Signer 2: Redwood Billing (ack invoice)
- Signer 3: Redwood Legal (countersign MSA)
This keeps control and creates auditable trail.

Samir L.: For countersign path I'll add clause: "Countersign is effective upon signature by both parties; however, provisioning may proceed on PO receipt at Redwood's discretion for POC only." That protects us.

June F.: Confirmed. Also add invoice metadata in the orderform snippet so Billing can auto-ingest. Example snippet to include in orderform (please paste into the form):
```
billing_contact: billing@acmehealth.com
po_number: <buyer_po_number>
net_terms: 45
currency: USD
amount: <total_amount>
```

Oleg P.: Buyer accepted that snippet. They also asked for credits: "If we exceed trial usage, will Redwood prorate monthly?" Answer: yes, standard prorate; Marcus can confirm.

Marcus B.: I'll confirm prorate and credits in the follow-up email. Also will create DocuSign envelope with the exact signing order above.

DocuSignBot: Envelope created — https://docusign.example/envelopes/0b6a3f — status: waiting_for_signatures :mailbox_with_mail:

Maria H.: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- Samir: redline + MSA clause for KMS and countersign language (EOD)
- June: approve Net45 one-off for this POC and confirm tax form process (EOD)
- Marcus: create DocuSign envelope and confirm prorate language to buyer (today)
- Oleg: share buyer PO scan here once received

(reacts) :thumbsup:
